text.en: 1. These Regulations may be cited as the Immigration (Special Entry and Clearance Arrangements) Regulations.

heading.en: Evidence of identity and Singapore citizenship
Waiver of passport, etc., production for certain citizens
Disapplication of section 5A(1)(b) of Act to certain non-citizens
Disapplication of section 5A(1) of Act to cross-border railway incident management officers

text.en:
5.—(1) The requirements under section 5A(1) of the Act do not apply to the following individuals, whether a citizen of Singapore or a non-citizen:
(a)a Singapore border protection service officer who travels to or from Singapore for the purpose or in the course of his performing duties as a Singapore incident management officer in respect of a cross-border railway affected by a railway occurrence necessitating incident management operations;
(b)a Malaysian border protection service officer who travels to or from Singapore for the purpose or in the course of his performing duties as a Malaysian incident management officer in respect of a cross-border railway affected by a railway occurrence necessitating incident management operations.
(2) Any term in paragraph (1) that is defined in the Cross-Border Railways (Border Control Co-location) Act 2026 has the meaning given to that term in that Act.
[S 682/2026 wef 30/09/2026]
